description: The inside face of the wall, and a path along it worn smooth by the daily round. Up close the thorn is not a hedge, it is an argument that took thirty years: layered, pegged, cut back and let go and cut back again, the salvage lattice long since swallowed. A crew is working a section with hooks and heavy gloves, and what they are doing is not repairing it. They are pruning it.
name: The Thorn Walk
